name: étude Prologue ~Yureugoku Kokoro no Katachi~
original_name: étude prologue 〜揺れ動く心のかたち〜
source:
A coastal town called "South Aose". Surrounded by the sea and mountains, a place like anywhere where lots of nature still remains. Two normal high school students go to school in that town.

The special winter of the 3rd year of school. The students worry about their future paths and the loves they can't be honest about. With many thoughts in their hearts, the final season starts now...

What do you desire? Where will you go? What is the shape of a girl or boy's trembling heart?
The time when the two protagonists meet again, that is when their story starts to move once more.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/etude_ps2/etude_story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
海滨小镇“南青濑”被大海与群山环绕，是一座随处可见、仍保留着丰富自然风光的地方。两名普通高中生就在镇上读书。

高中三年级那个特别的冬天，学生们为未来道路而烦恼，也为无法坦率表达的爱情而苦闷。怀着无数思绪，最后的季节如今开始…

你渴望什么？将去往哪里？少女或少年轻轻摇曳的心，究竟是什么形状？
两名主人公再次相遇之时，他们的故事也将重新开始转动。

[翻译自[url=http://www.takuyo.co.jp/products/etude_ps2/etude_story.html]官方网站[/url]]
